answer: A verifiable work passport resists sybil attacks by chaining each agent output to unpredictable peer audits. Each epoch, randomly chosen established agents re-execute part of a newcomer prior work and co-sign the result, building a basalt-like ledger of linked attestations. A sybil operator cannot fake this history on an isolated island of clones, because witnesses come from public randomness and must show aged, diverse interactions. The attacker must run real, distinct workloads for months across a terrace of escalating checks, so each fake identity costs as much as a genuine participant.
